blocks.raw: # Schedule Report
blocks.text: Schedule Report

blocks.raw: The Schedule Report function allows you to automate report scheduling, offering options such as daily, weekly, monthly, or fixed times. Once scheduled, the system automatically sends these reports via email to designated recipients. Each email includes scorecards displaying all Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) from the report, along with the option to download the report as an Excel file and a direct link to view it on Insights+. You can customize the email, add a personalized message, and embed KPIs directly within the email. Both Standard and Custom Reports can be scheduled.

blocks.text: Creating Schedule

blocks.raw: To Schedule a Report, do the following:
blocks.text: To Schedule a Report, do the following:

blocks.raw:
1. Open the report you want to schedule. Customize the report if required using the available report filters and chart dimensions
2. On the top-right of the report, click the **More** Options icon >**Schedules**. This shows the existing list of schedules for that report.

Schedule Name Specify a name for the schedule job.

blocks.raw: # Applying filters and Dimensions to a Scheduled Custom Report
blocks.text: Applying filters and Dimensions to a Scheduled Custom Report

blocks.raw: You can apply filters and dimensions to a custom report that you want to schedule.
blocks.text: You can apply filters and dimensions to a custom report that you want to schedule.

blocks.raw: To set filters and dimensions:
blocks.text: To set filters and dimensions:

blocks.raw:
1. Open a custom report 2. Click the **More** Options icon > **Edit**. 3. Add the required filters and dimensions 4. Click **Save**
In recurring jobs, whenever the scheduler runs, you will get a report with prefilled filters and dimensions.

blocks.raw: # Editing Schedule
blocks.text: Editing Schedule

blocks.raw: Any running schedule can be edited as per the users requirements. All the parameters originally used to create the schedule can be modified. To edit a schedule:
blocks.text: Any running schedule can be edited as per the users requirements. All the parameters originally used to create the schedule can be modified. To edit a schedule:

blocks.raw:
1. Navigate to the desired report and click the **More** Options icon > **Schedules**
2. For the desired schedule click the **More** Options icon > **Edit**.
3. Do the required changes and click **Save**.

blocks.raw: # Pausing/ Resuming Schedule
blocks.text: Pausing/ Resuming Schedule

blocks.raw: Any running schedule can be paused before it is executed. To pause a schedule:
blocks.text: Any running schedule can be paused before it is executed. To pause a schedule:

blocks.raw:
1. Navigate to the desired report and click the **More** Options icon > **Schedules**
2. For the desired schedule, click the **More** Options icon > **Pause**. The schedule gets paused and a Schedule paused notification appears.
3. To resume the paused schedule, click **Pause**> **Resume**.
blocks.text: Navigate to the desired report and click the More Options icon > SchedulesFor the desired schedule, click the More Options icon > Pause. The schedule gets paused and a Schedule paused notification appears.To resume the paused schedule, click Pause> Resume.

blocks.raw: ## Unsubscribing/ Subscribing to a scheduled report
blocks.text: Unsubscribing/ Subscribing to a scheduled report

blocks.raw: Recipients of a scheduled report receive reports through emails according to the scheduled frequency. However, a recipient can unsubscribe from a scheduled job manually to stop receiving reports. Also, an unsubscribed recipient can subscribe again to receive reports.
blocks.text: Recipients of a scheduled report receive reports through emails according to the scheduled frequency. However, a recipient can unsubscribe from a scheduled job manually to stop receiving reports. Also, an unsubscribed recipient can subscribe again to receive reports.

blocks.raw: To unsubscribe or subscribe to a scheduled report:
blocks.text: To unsubscribe or subscribe to a scheduled report:

blocks.raw:
1. Navigate to the desired report and click the **More** Options icon > **Schedules**
2. For the desired schedule, click the **More** Options icon > **Request to unsubscribe**.
3. If you are unsubscribed from a scheduled job and want to subscribe again, click the **More** Options icon > **Request to subscribe**.
